content.text: Which of the following coordinates points to the object closest to the camera? The coordinates are represented in (y x) format where each number is between 0 and 1000. (0 0) represents the top left of the image while (1000 1000) represents the bottom right. Choices:  A. (143 485). B. (454 75). C. (502 373). D. (360 273). Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
